column1: # Self-time by symbol, SwiftQL full fetch -- baseline arm
# Captured with `sample` on the main thread of the issue #250 comparison
# harness running the `swiftql` implementation, for three seconds after one
# second of run time. Self time is a node's sample count less the sum of its
# immediate children. Percentages are of the 2498 main-thread samples.
# This pair of files replaces nothing: `self-time-by-symbol.tsv` remains the
# original six-second profile that located the cost. These two were captured
# with one tool, in one session, on one machine, so that the baseline and the
# candidate can be compared to each other.
